title: Higher gas prices set to lift Gas Malaysia earnings 16% in FY27
desc: RHB Research expects the Malaysia Reference Price to climb 28% next year, tracking this year's 21% rise in Brent with a nine-month lag.

title: Another PETRONAS tanker due in Melaka by early August
desc: The Prime Minister said the vessel will sail from Yanbu, Saudi Arabia through the Red Sea after clearance was granted.

title: PETRONAS signs LNG supply deal with Japan's Shizuoka Gas
desc: PETRONAS LNG will supply about 0.84 million tonnes a year for seven years from 2032, extending a partnership of three decades.

title: Searah Malaysia assumes operatorship of five upstream assets
desc: The PETRONAS-Eni joint venture began operations on 1 July, taking over production sharing contracts from PETRONAS Carigali.

title: Malaysia fuel supply secured to end-July amid Hormuz disruption
desc: PETRONAS extended its assurance by a month as Brent averaged around US$111, with subsidised fuel quotas trimmed to conserve supply.

title: PETRA Energy resumes production at Banang oilfield
desc: Production restarted in April after a 15-month pause for mandatory drydocking of the Petra Orion MOPU, offshore Terengganu.

title: PETRA Energy wins two-year SK407 field operations contract
desc: Awarded by Vestigo Petroleum to manage West Lutong, Baram, Tukau, Siwa and Fairly Baram fields off Miri, to March 2028.

title: Petra Resources accepts RM298m Bintulu hook-up work orders
desc: Four work orders from PETRONAS Carigali for hook-up and commissioning on Phase 2 of the Bintulu integrated facilities rejuvenation project.

title: PETRONAS launches Malaysia Bid Round 2026
desc: Nine exploration blocks across the Sandakan, West Sarawak and Malay basins, plus six discovered resource opportunities.
